title: Manufacturer Program Use at Retail Pharmacies under the Maximizer — Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit Coordination Note for the Specialty Pharmacy Program
content:
A manufacturer program under a maximizer can also be used at a retail pharmacy. Under the member's **Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit**, the network pharmacy bills the member's payment on a retail claim to the manufacturer program as secondary payer, after Northbridge Rx. That use reduces the benefit available to the member's Specialty Pharmacy Program enrollment for the same drug.

**Rule.** Program use at a retail pharmacy is the member's payment recorded on a paid retail claim for the same drug.

- When a benefit load is on the enrollment's ledger, and paid retail claims for the drug are dated fewer whole months before today than the first day of the load's program year, that program use is taken off the benefit available.
- When no load is on the ledger, and paid retail claims for the drug fall in the last 12 months, that program use is taken off the assistance balance shown on the enrollment.
- Otherwise nothing is taken off.

**Terms.**

- **Records read.** The retail records are the member's paid claims under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit for the specialty enrollment's therapy drug, each dated by its date of service. The program use is the member-paid amount recorded on each claim.
- **Program year.** The load's program year runs from January 1 to December 31 of the year named on the latest benefit load.
- **Last 12 months.** This means fewer than 12 whole months before today.
- **Whole months.** The number of whole months between a date and today is the count of calendar months from that date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than that date's day of the month.

## Ladder

| Benefit load on the ledger | Paid retail claims for the drug in the window | Program use taken off |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | dated fewer whole months before today than January 1 of the load's program year | the member's payments recorded on those claims |
| No | within the last 12 months | the member's payments recorded on those claims, taken off the assistance balance shown |
| either | none in the applicable window | zero |

## Cases (assumed: today is 2026-08-25; January 1, 2026 lies 7 whole months back)

- *Load for program year 2026.* Assume paid retail claims for the drug dated 2026-02-27, with $60.00 member paid, and 2026-07-30, with $60.00 member paid. Their whole months before today are 5 and 0, so program use is $120.00.
- *Same load, and the only retail claim for the drug is dated 2026-01-10.* That claim lies 7 whole months back, which is not fewer than 7, so nothing is taken off.
- *No load, and a paid retail claim for the drug dated 2025-10-02 with $45.00 member paid.* That claim lies 10 whole months back, within the last 12 months, so $45.00 is taken off the assistance balance shown.
